## What We Covered Today {.smaller}

[Day 01 · wrap]{.eyebrow}

### Today's tour, in two cards

::: {.recap}
**Python visualization ecosystem**

- matplotlib (figure anatomy, building plots step by step)
- seaborn (statistical visualizations, clustermap)
- plotly (interactive counterparts)
- Setting up a reproducible environment
:::

::: fragment
::: {.recap}
**Genomics plot types**

| Plot | Library | Use case |
|------|---------|----------|
| Volcano | matplotlib / DashBio | Differential expression |
| PCA / t-SNE / UMAP | scikit-learn | Dimensionality reduction |
| Heatmap | seaborn / PyComplexHeatmap | Expression matrices |
| Waffle | PyWaffle | Proportions |
| Waterfall | matplotlib | Mutation burden |
| Peaks | pyGenomeTracks / matplotlib | ChIP-seq / ATAC-seq |
| Pathway | gget / gseapy | Enrichment results |
:::
:::

### Days 2 and 3 preview

**Day 2 (Tuesday 13:00 – 18:00):**

- Stacked bar plots
- Time series plots

::: fragment
**Day 3 (Wednesday 13:00 – 18:00):**

- Phylogenetic trees (`Toytree`, `Bio.Phylo`)
- Circos plots (`pyCirclize`)
- Venn diagrams & UpSet plots (`matplotlib-venn`, `UpSetPlot`)
- Synteny plots (`JCVI / MCscan`)
- Ideograms
